title: Manager/Assistant Manager-Academic Administration
description:
**Job Description**

**Department:**
GSB Academic Administration

**Location:**
Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh

**Experience:**
5+ years of relevant experience

**Educational Qualification:**
A postgraduate degree from a recognised institution

**Reporting To:**
Senior Manager – GSB Academic Administration

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Compensation:**
As per University norms

**About the Role**

The Graduate School of Business (GSB) at Krea University is seeking an experienced and organised professional to manage the academic and administrative operations of the MBA Programme Office. The Manager will be responsible for the smooth functioning of the programme, covering academic planning, course scheduling, faculty coordination, student support, financial administration and related activities.

The role involves working closely with the Programme Chair, faculty members, students and University departments to ensure effective coordination and timely execution of academic processes. While the primary responsibility will be the MBA Programme Office, the Manager will also extend operational support to BBA, EMBA, MDP and other GSB programmes, as and when required. The Manager will work under the guidance of the Senior Manager – GSB Academic Administration and support the consistent implementation of approved processes and operational priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. MBA Programme Operations and Academic Planning**

**•**
Manage the day-to-day academic and administrative operations of the MBA Programme Office, ensuring smooth delivery of programme activities.

**• C**
ourse scheduling, timetable preparation, classroom allocation, rescheduling and other academic arrangements.

**•**
Coordinate with Area Chairs and faculty members for course planning, faculty finalisation, course outlines and academic requirements.

**•**
Manage course registration, add/drop processes and elective selection in consultation with the Programme Chair and relevant stakeholders.

**•**
Ensure adherence to the academic calendar and timely completion of academic activities and deadlines.

**•**
Coordinate procurement and distribution of textbooks, case studies and other course materials; maintain programme manuals, calendars and related documentation.

**2. Faculty and Visiting Faculty Coordination**

**•**
Act as the primary administrative point of contact for MBA faculty members and Visiting Faculty.

**•**
Coordinate faculty onboarding, teaching schedules, course requirements, contracts and related documentation.

**•**
Manage visiting faculty arrangements, including travel, accommodation, local transportation and hospitality.

**•**
Track faculty teaching hours, additional teaching assignments and related approvals; coordinate honorarium, payments and reimbursements with Finance and other concerned departments.

**•**
Ensure timely communication of academic schedules, changes and programme-related requirements to faculty members.

**3. ERP, LMS and Academic Data Management**

**•**
Ensure accurate and timely updating of academic information in the University’s ERP and Canvas Learning Management System.

**•**
Oversee course creation, student enrolment, faculty allocation, timetable updates and other academic data entries.

**•**
Coordinate student feedback processes and consolidate feedback reports for review.

**•**
Maintain academic trackers and reports relating to attendance, scheduling, faculty workload and other programme activities.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve data accuracy, reporting and the effective use of academic systems.

**•**
Liaise with ERP and IT teams to resolve system-related issues and facilitate process improvements.

**4. Financial and Budget Administration**

**•**
Manage the financial and administrative requirements of the MBA Programme Office within approved budgets and University procedures.

**•**
Prepare and maintain budget trackers, expenditure statements and financial records.

**•**
Coordinate purchase requests, invoices, payment processing and reimbursements with Finance and other concerned departments.

**•**
Monitor budget utilisation and bring deviations or additional financial requirements to the attention of the Senior Manager for necessary action.

**•**
Ensure timely submission of supporting documents and closure of financial transactions.

**5. Guest Lectures, Krea Talks and Academic Events**

**•**
Coordinate guest lectures, Krea Talks, industry interactions and other academic engagements for the MBA programme.

**•**
Liaise with faculty members, guest speakers and relevant University departments for planning and execution.

**•**
Manage speaker communication, travel, accommodation, transportation, hospitality and venue arrangements.

**•**
Ensure timely completion of pre-event, on-the-day and post-event requirements, and maintain event records, attendance details and expenditure documentation.

**6. Team Coordination and Process Management**

**•**
Oversee the day-to-day allocation and execution of responsibilities within the MBA Programme Office team.

**•**
Monitor task progress, pending activities and timelines to ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities.

**•**
Guide and support team members in handling academic and administrative activities.

**•**
Ensure proper documentation, handovers and continuity of work during staff absences.

**•**
Implement SOPs, templates, trackers and workflows in consultation with the Senior Manager.

**•**
Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and consistency.

**•**
Provide periodic updates to the Senior Manager on programme operations, pending matters and key operational challenges.

**7. Support to Other GSB Programmes**

**•**
Extend academic and administrative support to BBA, EMBA, MDP and other GSB programmes, as and when required.

**•**
Provide operational coverage during staff absences, peak academic periods and key programme activities.

**•**
Maintain a working understanding of the academic calendars, processes and requirements of other programmes to facilitate effective coordination.

**Qualifications, Skills and Competencies:**

**•**
Prior experience in higher education, preferably in academic administration or managing an academic programme office.

**•**
Good understanding of academic operations, course scheduling, faculty coordination, examination processes and student administration.

**•**
Experience in coordinating teams and managing multiple academic and administrative activities.

**•**
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, and familiarity with ERP and Learning Management Systems. Knowledge of Canvas will be an advantage.

**•**
Strong organisational, planning, coordination and problem-solving skills.

**•**
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with faculty, students, colleagues and senior management.

**•**
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and handle time-sensitive requirements.

**•**
Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

**•**
Ability to work collaboratively with different University departments and stakeholders.

**•**
A proactive approach towards identifying operational challenges and improving administrative processes.

**•**
Flexibility to support academic activities beyond regular working hours and on weekends, as required. Compensatory time off will be provided when a full working day is undertaken on a weekend.

*The responsibilities outlined above represent the key result areas of the role and are not exhaustive. Additional responsibilities may be assigned from time to time based on departmental and University requirements.*

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their relevant experience, and contact information to
**careers@krea.edu.in**

**Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Senior Manager-Campus Operations
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Senior Manager-Campus Operations

**Department:**
Campus Operations

**Work Location:**
Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh

**Reporting to:**
Associate Director

**Position:**
Full -Time

**Experience:**
3-5 Years

**Educational Qualification**
: BE/B. Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering

**Additional Requirements:**
Valid C Licence / applicable electrical licence

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day MEP and technical operations covering Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire & Life Safety, DG, STP, RO, lifts and other critical infrastructure.
* Manage HT/LT electrical systems, including 11 kV / 33 kV incoming supply, HT yard, transformers, DGs and distribution systems.
* Manage and coordinate the technical/maintenance team, including manpower deployment, performance, training and 24x7 operational support.
* Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance and ensure timely response and closure of breakdowns.
* Manage technical vendors, contractors, AMCs/OEMs and monitor SLA/KPI compliance.
* Maintain and monitor asset records, equipment history, warranties, AMC/CMC details and lifecycle/replacement requirements.
* Drive sustainability, energy conservation, utility optimization and cost-saving initiatives.
* Handle general administrative and operational coordination with internal departments to ensure smooth day-to-day campus operations.
* Identify and implement new initiatives and technologies to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Support CAPEX planning, technical evaluations, procurement and implementation of projects.
* Prepare and review operational MIS, maintenance reports, utility consumption and performance reports.
* Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, audits and required certifications.
* Analyse recurring failures and coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and support the Associate Director in overall Campus Operations.

**What we are looking for:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering – Essential.
* Valid C License / applicable electrical license – Essential.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in facilities, campus, institutional, commercial or similar operations.
* Hands-on experience in 11 kV / 33 kV HT systems and operations – Essential.
* Experience in MEP operations, maintenance and technical team management.
* Experience in vendor/contractor management and administration.
* Good communication, coordination, reporting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in a large residential/institutional campus will be preferred.
* Exposure to sustainability, energy management, asset management and CAPEX projects will be preferred.
* Master’s degree / MBA / M.Tech is desirable but not mandatory.

**Key Expectations:**

* The candidate should be proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to independently manage day-to-day technical operations and general administrative and operational requirements, anticipate potential issues and take timely corrective action.
* The candidate should be capable of analysing problems, developing practical solutions and ensuring effective resolution.
* The candidate should take ownership of critical infrastructure, maintenance and assigned operational responsibilities, while effectively coordinating the technical team, vendors and internal stakeholders. The role requires a strong focus on reliability, service quality, safety and operational efficiency, along with the ability to identify and implement opportunities for energy savings, cost optimisation and continuous improvement.
* The candidate should have good administrative, communication, coordination and reporting skills and work closely with the Associate Director to ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of Campus Operations.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their relevant experience, and contact information
**careers@krea.edu.in**
with subject: Candidate Name\_ Application for Sr. Manager-Operations

**Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Assistant Manager - Project Management
description:
**Position Title:**
Assistant Manager - Project Management

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description**

The Assistant Manager - Project Management is responsible for driving the strategic planning, cross-functional coordination, financial oversight, and site execution of multi-million dollar Greenfield and Brownfield manufacturing infrastructure projects. Sitting at the core of project governance, this role defines program roadmaps, manages critical path interdependencies across engineering, legal, construction, and supply chain teams, and acts as the primary liaison for executive leadership, contractors, and regulatory agencies. The incumbent maintains strict financial control over CAPEX budgets, proactively mitigates supply chain and regulatory risks, and ensures all built infrastructure adheres to local building codes, safety protocols, and ESG targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Planning & Roadmapping:**
  Define multi-year project roadmaps, establish critical path milestones, and align interdependencies across engineering, construction, procurement, and legal functions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Serve as the central point of contact connecting executive leadership, government agencies, municipal authorities, civil contractors, and local community partners.
* **Financial Oversight & Budgeting:**
  Manage multi-million dollar project budgets, oversee CAPEX forecasting, control procurement approvals, and maintain contingency allocation plans.
* **Risk Mitigation & Governance:**
  Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and regulatory risks to formulate actionable "Plan B" contingency scenarios.
* **Quality, ESG & Statutory Compliance:**
  Ensure infrastructure developments comply with local building codes, occupational safety protocols, and corporate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) targets.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering combined with an MBA.
* **Experience:**
  5+ years of hands-on project management experience executing Greenfield and Brownfield manufacturing facility projects within the automotive sector.
* **Certifications:**
  PMP (Project Management Professional) or PgMP (Program Management Professional) strongly preferred.
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end program governance, CAPEX oversight, statutory/regulatory liaisoning, cross-functional leadership, and PMP/PgMP methodology execution.

title: Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly(Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly (Projects & ME)

Location: Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Engine Assembly (Projects & ME) drives the end-to-end planning, process design, equipment procurement, and commissioning of engine assembly lines. Sitting at the intersection of manufacturing engineering and Industry 4.0, this role reviews engineering drawings, conducts capacity/cycle time studies, designs Poka-Yoke and automation interlocks, and manages the complete machine procurement lifecycle (RFQ to PO release). The incumbent oversees machine proving trials at supplier facilities and on-site, ensures seamless new model ramp-up, resolves quality non-conformances and breakdown issues during stabilization, enforces IMS/safety standards, and implements PLC, robotics, and IIoT digitization initiatives across engine assembly operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Planning & Line Balancing:**
  Review engineering drawings to design assembly processes, perform capacity and cycle time studies, and establish baseline manufacturing parameters.
* **Pre-Production & Poka-Yoke Design:**
  Conceptualize processes, evaluate line automation, and implement error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) systems and safety interlocks.
* **Procurement & Machine Proving:**
  Prepare RFQs, execute techno-commercial evaluations, approve machine designs, and lead proving trials at both supplier works and on-site assembly lines.
* **Line Stabilization & Ramp-Up:**
  Drive new model stabilization, verify designed cycle times/capacity, resolve quality non-conformances (NCs), troubleshoot machine breakdowns, and close safety compliance actions.
* **Smart Manufacturing & IMS Governance:**
  Program PLCs/robots, integrate IIoT/digitization frameworks, and maintain Integrated Management System (IMS) documentation.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Mechatronics from a reputed institution.
* **Experience:**
  5–6 years of relevant hands-on manufacturing engineering experience within the automotive OEM or Tier-1 engine manufacturing sector.
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end machine commissioning, engine proving trials, PLC/Robot programming, Poka-Yoke interlocks, and rapid model ramp-up stabilization.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**ob Description**

The Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME) is responsible for the process planning, industrialization, robotic automation, and technical validation of chassis and frame fabrication lines. Sitting at the core of structural manufacturing engineering, this role leads the development of advanced joining processes (MIG, TIG, Resistance, Laser, and Friction Stir Welding), robotic programming (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), WPS/PQR specifications, and metallurgical validation. The incumbent oversees the complete project lifecycle—from DFMEA/PFMEA design reviews and fixture/gauge procurement to Cpk/Ppk trials, PPAP approval, ergonomic line balancing (MOST), and SBP strategic capacity planning—ensuring high weld quality, safety compliance, and zero-defect mass production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Planning & Weld Engineering:**
  Formulate Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, WPS/PQR standards, and torch/parameter sequences across manual and robotic joining lines (MIG/TIG/Spot/Laser).
* **Robotic Automation & Line Setup:**
  Program and commission robotic welding cells (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), integrate automated seam tracking, design ergonomic layouts, and optimize cycle times using MOST.
* **Tooling, Jigs & Fixture Development:**
  Conceptualize, procure, and prove out welding jigs, locators, Poka-Yoke clamping mechanisms, gauges, and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) with vendors.
* **Metallurgical Validation & Quality Control:**
  Perform mechanical testing (tensile, bend, macro/micro, hardness) and NDT inspections to guarantee weld penetration, structural integrity, and IATF 16949 / ISO 3834 compliance.
* **NPD, APQP & Industrialization:**
  Lead cross-functional trials for New Product Development (NPD), execute ECN updates, drive APQP/PPAP sign-offs, and prove line capability (Cpk/Ppk) for mass production readiness.
* **Operational Excellence & Cost Optimization:**
  Drive VA/VE projects, scrap reduction, setup time optimization (SMED), OEE improvements, and long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) budget/capacity projections.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Automotive, or Mechatronics Engineering.

**Experience Requirements by Band:**

* **Senior Engineer:**
  3–6 years of hands-on experience independently managing fabrication process setups, NPD trials, and improvement projects.
* **Deputy Manager:**
  9–12+ years of leadership experience driving SBP long-term roadmaps, mentoring engineering teams, upgrading plant technology, and projecting multi-year capital budgets.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)

**Location:**

**Job Description**

The Senior Engineer / Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME) oversees the process engineering, facility readiness, CNC programming, and tooling set-up for critical in-house engine components (Crankcase, Cylinder Head, Cylinder Barrel, Clutch/Magneto Covers, and Crankshafts). The incumbent analyzes engineering blueprints and tolerances to define operational sequences, set cutting parameters, and program Fanuc-controlled CNC machines. This role ensures shop-floor productivity by addressing bottleneck stations, managing special processes (Grinding, Industrial Washing, and Leak Testing), reducing cycle times, driving cost-saving initiatives, and coordinating predictive/preventive maintenance to maintain high facility availability across engine machining operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Blueprint Analysis & Process Planning:**
  Study engineering drawings, specs, and tolerances to determine operational sequences, parameters (speed, feed, cut depth/angle), and fixture setups for engine components.
* **CNC Programming & Tooling Setup:**
  Develop, edit, and optimize CNC programs using Fanuc controllers; select, align, and secure workholding fixtures, cutting tools, and accessories.
* **Special Process & Line Management:**
  Oversee specialized machining operations, including precision grinding, industrial component washing, and high-pressure leak testing equipment.
* **Line Balancing & Bottleneck Optimization:**
  Analyze cycle time, takt time, and throughput to identify critical bottleneck stations and optimize work allocation across the shop floor.
* **Facility Readiness & Maintenance:**
  Support predictive/preventive maintenance routines, ensure continuous machine availability, and resolve field failures and production line issues promptly.
* **Productivity & Continuous Improvement:**
  Drive cost-reduction initiatives, improve line productivity, and apply structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve quality and operational non-conformances.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Automotive Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  12+ years of hands-on machining process engineering experience within the automotive OEM or engine manufacturing sector (preferably two-wheeler or light vehicle IC engines).
* **Core Competencies:**
  Fanuc CNC programming, precision component machining, special process machine handling (Grinding/Washing/Leak Testing), takt time optimization, and shop-floor troubleshooting.

title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager  - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)**

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Vehicle Assembly) is responsible for driving line balancing, process optimization, layout designing, and facility commissioning across vehicle assembly operations. Sitting at the intersection of process engineering and Industry 4.0, this role leads the procurement and integration of tooling, jigs, fixtures, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) testing facilities, and Low-Cost Automation (LCA) solutions. The incumbent executes line trials, implements ergonomic improvements (REBA/RULA), drives PFMEA and quality non-conformance root cause analysis, and embeds MES/IIoT traceability (Vehicle Genealogy) to ensure high-efficiency, safe, and cost-effective assembly operations up to final handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Line Balancing & Process Optimization:**
  Conduct time studies and workflow analyses to eliminate Non-Value-Added (NVA) activities, balancing assembly lines to boost efficiency and operational productivity.
* **Facility & Tooling Development:**
  Design plant layouts for expansions and handle end-to-end procurement (RFQ to DAP trials, site installation, and commissioning) for tools, jigs, fixtures, Poka-Yokes, and ABS testing facilities.
* **Industry 4.0 & Digital Manufacturing:**
  Integrate Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IIoT networks, and Vehicle Genealogy tracking while executing Low-Cost Automation (LCA) and ergonomic upgrades (REBA/RULA).
* **Quality Governance & PFMEA:**
  Collaborate with Quality to resolve process non-conformances using 8D/A3 tools, update PFMEAs and Control Plans, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Cross-Functional & Packaging Support:**
  Provide daily shop-floor engineering support, resolve line bottlenecks, drive VAVE/cost-reduction projects, and oversee CKD packaging standards and material handling systems.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering / process engineering within automotive vehicle assembly environments (OEMs or major Tier-1 system integrators)
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end RFQ-to-commissioning execution, MES/IIoT integration, ABS facility testing, line balancing, and ergonomic workstation design
